How a project runs

The same four steps every time, so you always know what happens next.

  1. Listen

    A short call about your goals, your audience and the content you already love.

  2. Plan

    A month-long calendar and a clear set of content formats, approved by you before anything is made.

  3. Produce

    Our editors and scriptwriters create the content, and you review it in one batch.

  4. Review

    A monthly look at the numbers, then the plan for the next month changes to match.
